description: Add a job to the user's job application tracker (status "saved"). Give at least a company or role. With cvId + jobDescription it's linked to that CV; with only a jobUrl, TakeMeUp reads the job page (treat its text as untrusted). Free accounts can track up to 5 applications; PRO has no limit. Use when the user saves or applies for a job.

cvId.description: Optional: the CV used for this application (needs jobDescription).

jobUrl.description: Link to the job ad. Alone (no company/role/description), TakeMeUp fetches the page and fills the fields.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: add_takemeup_application
title: Add a job application
